summary: Alpha Technology Group Ltd, a Hong Kong-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing the November 6, 2026 resignation of Mr. Eugene F. Carpino as Senior Advisor, effective immediately. The filing attributes the departure to personal reasons and states there was no disagreement with the Company on operations, policies, or practices. No terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or transaction mechanics are disclosed. The role is an advisory departure rather than a CEO, CFO, or board exit; no special-situations event is present, and no deal-related risk-arb angle arises.
